name: The Gorton household at 2120 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_gorton_frank_s

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 2120 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903); the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904) prints nothing at 2120. The household left within that year, and whether it was still in the house on 1 July 1904 is not documented.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 2120. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. A house of this kind kept live-in staff, and the 1900 and 1910 censuses name them; neither was read for this card, so no staff are listed. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.
